tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan bla ma rmog cog pa chen po'i rnam par thar pa bzhugs so// bla ma mnyam med rin po che/ /yon tan kun 'byung lhun gyis grub/ /skal ldan sangs rgyas ngo sprod pa'i/ /rje rtogs ldan rnams kyi zhabs la 'dud/ bdag gis chos sgor zhugs nas bla ma brten pa dang / /sgro 'dogs chod nas nyams su blangs pa dang / /nges shes skyes nas sems thag chod pa dang / /'di drug kho bo'i rnam par thar pa lags/ /de la dang po bdag gis lo bcu drug lon nas bcu bdun du 'gro ba la zhong zhong du chos sgor zhugs te/ lo gcig 'dul ba mnyan nas/ bla ma la dges rdor gyi dbang zhus pas khyod kyis sems can la phan thogs pa gcig 'ong bar snang bas thos pa gcig byed dgos so/ /yang na khyod dgon dkar ba can du phar phyin nyon/ yang na lcang ra ba la byams pa'i chos lnga nyan du song / /dpe cha rnams ngas bya yis gsungs/ de nas lcang ra ba can du 'gro dgos snyam tsa na/ de'i dbyar de bla ma jo bo rlung mos lha phur spyan drangs nas/ mthing chung du dbyar chos gsungs pas/ ston pa 'brom ston dang brang khang gcig du stabs su bsdad pas/ dgong mo nyal tsa na nub mdun du btud nas khong na re/ nga 'dra ba'i bsod nams zad pa yong ba/ dge bshes 'gar ba la dbu tshad rnams mkhas par bslabs/ dge bshes bya yul ba lo bdun brten/ bka' pod 'di tshod gcig shes kyang zan rdog po gcig kyang ster mkhan med/ chos nyan mkhan gcig kyang med/ sems la yang phan par ma byung / zur chos pa bzhi po 'dis nga'i chos kyi sa bcad tsam re yang mi shes te/ chos nyan 'di tsam 'dug zer nas/ ngas 'brom ston pa chos nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por btang ba yin zer gyin gda' ba/ chos rang gis nyams su blangs pas chog pa ma lags sam zhus pas/ mchog thun mong gnyis las thun mong gi dngos grub mi nor zas gsum 'du ba yin te/ nga la ci yang mi 'dug thun mong med par mchog mi yong pa yin no/

/gros blo nyes po la bris bya ba yin pas/ khyod rang yang thos pa ma byed par nyams su long / bla ma 'di grub thob chen po yin pas/ gdams ngag zhus la sgoms/ thos pas ci la yang mi phan par 'dug go zer bas/ yar la 'gro ba'i spros pa des chod nas/ de nas dbyar chos thon pa dang / bla ma'i zhal nas/ rgyags grabs gyis shig ston yar la 'gro dgos gsungs pa la/ yar la 'gro ba'i blo de log nas gda'/ yar la phyin yang chos ci shes kyang cha med/ shes kyang sems la ni mi phan par 'dug 'brom ston na re gros blo nyes po la dris bya ba yin pas sgoms zer/ nga rang yang sgrub pa la spro bar byung bas ston nam zla bzang dus su bla ma la gdams ngag zhu dgos byas pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas btsun chung da rung sgom snga pa yin/ yang na slob gnyer gcig gyis/ yang na gnas gzhi'i bya ba en tsam gyis gsungs pa la/ kho bo'i bsam pa la thos pa ni de dang 'dra/ gnas gzhi'i bya ba byas tshad 'gyod pa las mi 'dug bla mas gdams ngag mi ster ba'i snyad du 'dug snyam nas/ bla ma'i thugs kyi sras slob dpon la tshangs pa 'di gces phrug gcig gis rgyas pa bcu drug dum gcig dang / longs spyod rgya chen po phul nas dbyar dgun bcu bdun bsten 'dug pas 'di la gdams ngag zab pa gcig zhu dgos snyam ste/ bya bur gcig byas nas nga nyams len gcig bya snyam nas bla ma la gdams ngag zhus pas ma gnang bas/ khyed rang nyams su len pa'i gdams ngag gcig zhu dgos byas pas/ khong gis gsung nas bla ma'i gsung bzhin du gzhon pa'i dus su thos pa byas na legs pa yin te/ khyed sgrub pa la mos na bla ma'i bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug bya ba yin pas gsungs nas/ mtsho skyes kyi bskyed rdzogs gnang nas sgom blo en tsam byas pas nyams myong tsam ma byung / de nas yul du phyin nas bla ma la gdams ngag zhu dgos byas pas mgon po dang nyi khros la sogs pa 'ga' gnang nas/

sngar skad gsungs te/ gzhon dus su thos pa byed dgos pa yin/ dge bshes g.yor mo rgya mo che nga la 'bul ba skyel du 'ong ba yod pas/ khong la phar phyin rnams nyan du 'gro gsungs nas/ gser zho drug dar yug drug mdo sde rgyan gyi po ti gcig gnang ngo / /de nas lo nyer gcig la slob dpon g.yor mo dang 'grogs nas dbus su phyin pas/ slob dpon stod lung la bzhud nas/ nga la skyi shod la shog gsungs nas/ skyi shod la 'ongs pas nangs par chu brgal snyam nas gnas gzhi gcig gi khyams su bsdad pas/ nyi ma rgas tsa na ston pa po ti theg tshad khur ba gcig byung ste/ po ti rnams bskur brang gcig brdungs te/ wa mar po chos 'di tsam shes kyang sems la yang ma phan/ zan rdog po gcig kyang mi rnyed pa 'dug zer nas grong gseb tu song ste/ phye gcig rnyed pa de 'gam gyin 'dug nas/ ston pa chos de tsam shes na brang brdungs nas ci byed/ chos sems la 'jog pa yin mod byas pas/ btsun chung khyod la chos kyi gnyer med kha rog sdod zer ro/ /de nas nub mo bsams pas/ shangs su 'brom ston na re/ gros blo nyes po la dris bya ba yin/ sgom khe che zer/ 'di nang po ti theg tshad khur nas brang brdung ba las mi 'dug pas/ da ngas chos bslab kyang ci shes kyang tshod med/ shes kyang 'di 'dra ba las mi 'dug snyam nas/ g.yor por ma phyin par/ skyi shod na yar phyin nas gdams ngag su che dris pas/ khams pa a seng bya ba dang po mtshan nyid pa chen po yin/ bar du bla ma dpal dga' lo la mos nas gdams pa zhus/ phyis 'khor rnams bkye nas sgrub pa byas pas/ da lta grub thob chen po byang sems can gdams ngag shin tu che ba gcig yod zer nas gnam du phyin pas rdzing kha na bzhugs 'dug der phyin pa dang dbang skur mdzad pa dang thug nas sa chog la ma sleb/ sta gon la sleb pas/ nga yang dbang gcig zhus nas gdams pa gcig zhu ba lags byas pas/

bla ma'i zhal nas khyod su'i slob ma yin gsungs/ nga shangs pa gdub bu ba'i slob ma yin byas pas/ rta bzang po la babs nas bong bu la bzhon pa cang yong ngam/ bla ma shangs pa las bzang ba da lta bod na med pas/ ngas khyod kyi slob dpon mi yong gsungs pas/ bdag ci nas kyang mos par byung bas/ dbang dang gdams pa thugs la 'dogs par zhu byas pas/ 'o na bya yis gsungs nas/ de nas dbang zhu ba'i dge bshes chen po cha pa dang / nyang ran chos seng dang / kyi pho tshul 'phags dang / g.yor gnyan dang / bla ma zhang dang / ston 'bum la sogs pa drug cu tsam 'dus nas gda' bas/ khong rnams na re/ bla ma shangs pa'i bden pa gnyis po de blor ma shong bas ci tsug 'dod pa yin zer ba la/ kun rdzob don dam gnyis las/ kun rdzob la yang log pa dang / yang dag pa gnyis la bod rnams kyang mi mthun/ don dam pa la spros pa phyogs tsam chod pa rnam grangs kyi don dam pa dang rgyu rkyen 'bras bu phan gnod thams cad dang bral ba blo'i yul du ma gyur pa de rnam grangs ma yin pa'i don dam pa ste/ 'bum las/ don dam pa la las med/ las kyi rnam par smin pa med/ kun nas nyon mongs pa yang med do/ /rnam par byang ba yang med do zhes gsungs pas/ don dam pa grub pa med pa las/ don dam pa grub par 'dod pa'i mkhas pa 'khrul byas pas/ dge bshes de rnams na re/ khyed bla ma shangs pa'i slob mar 'dug grub mtha' skyong shes par 'dug zer ba dang / bla ma a seng gi zhal nas/ bla ma gdub bu ba'i don dam phan med gnod med de la/ nga yang dang po ma bde ba byung ba yin ste/ da nga la go rgyu bsha' ma gcig byung bas khyed rang rnams ma bde ba yod na nga la dris shig ngas lan gdab bo gsungs pa dang / khams pa lo ts+tsha ba ston 'bum bya ba shes rab che ba gcig na re/ don dam rang gi ngo bo la phan med gnod med gcig yin te/ don dam ma rtogs pa'i blo la phan gnod byung ba de yang /

don dam spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba'i chod nyid rtogs pas sangs rgyas te/ de kas phan btags pa ma lags sam zer ba la/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ bla ma shangs pa'i mkhas la btsun pa shes rab che ba yin gsungs/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dang / grub thob rnams la gtugs pa yin pa la/ don dam phan med gnod med bya ba ci la yong / don dam spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i chos nyid dang po thos pas gtan la phab/ bar du bsam byung gi shes rab kyis nges su bcug tha ma sgom byung gi shes rab kyis ji lta ba bzhin gtan la phab/ de ltar rtogs nas sangs rgyas pa de ka phan rtags pa yin snyam pa gcig byung ba la/ de ltar du mi 'dug ste/ phan rgyu rtogs rgyu gcig byung ba de ka yang dag pa'i kun rdzob tu 'dug ste/ zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ don dam blo'i spyod yul min/ /blo dang sgra ni kun rdzob bo/ /zhes pa'i dgongs pa dang mthun par gda' bas/ don dam rang phan med gnod med/ spangs thob ma grub pas/ blo'i yul las 'das pa gcig rang du 'dug pas khong gis dgongs nas 'dug gsungs so/ /de nas dngos gzhi'i nub mo rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi dus su/ 'di sangs rgyas dngos yin snyam pa'i 'du shes bcos ma ma yin pa skyes/ dbang thob nas zhag nyi shu tham par gdams pa rnams zhus so/ /de yang gsang sngags smin grol gnyis las/ smin byed kyi dbang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dbang bzhi rdzogs par zhus pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur ba gnyis su snang / de gnyis ka lu hi pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs par mthun gsungs pa dang / grol lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis las/ bskyed rim la lū hi pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs par sgom pa dang / lhan skyes rdzogs par sgom pa gnyis so/ /rdzogs rim la rtsa rlung lus sbyong dang bcas pa ste/ sbyor drug rtsa 'grel gnyis/

sbyor phreng rtsa 'grel gnyis/ snying po gsum gsal ba rtsa 'grel gnyis dang / rdzogs rim de rnams zhus/ dbyar gye rer slob dpon can du bsdad nas rlung bum pa can 'ga' re bsgoms/ de nas slob dpon a seng de thugs dam la gtso bor mdzad pa'am/ mi mang pos sun nas ri khrod sha stag la bzhugs nas/ lo re la chos zhag bcu gsum las mi gsung bar dam bcas 'dug pas/ mjal sa mi yong bar 'dug ston ka bur du phyin nas zhag gsum bsdad pas/ bur na shug pa'i gseb na dgon pa skyid po gcig 'dug nas/ dgon pa ya gi na su yod pa yin byas pas/ bla ma bur sgom nag po bya ba rje ras chung pa'i slob ma gdams pa can gcig yod pa yin zer bas de la mos par byung nas/ bu ram bre gang khyer nas dgon par phyin tsa na/ khyi dkar po mi za ba yin zer ba gcig pur byung / de na rnal 'byor pa be'u phrug gyon pa bsgoms thag bcug pa gcig 'dug nas jo bo su bzhed zer/ nga bla ma bur sgom 'dod pa lags byas pas/ 'o na nang du tsha ba la 'dong zer nas phyin pas/ bla ma gar bzhugs byas pas/ bur sgom bur sgom zer ba de ka nga yin gsungs nas/ nye gnas kyang mi gda'/ de nas bu ram des phyag rten byas pa dang / jo bo khyed gang nas yin gsungs/ nga g.yas ru shangs nas 'ongs/ bla ma shangs pa gdub bu pa'i slob ma yin/ nā ro pa'i chos 'di la mos par byung nas thugs la 'dogs par zhu byas pas/ khong gi zhal nas jo bo khyed rta las babs nas bong bu la bzhon pas gang na 'ong / bla ma shangs pa mkhas btsun de lta bu bzhag nas/ nga rnal 'byor pa gcig la chos zhus pas gang na 'ong gsungs/ cis kyang thugs la 'dogs par zhu byas pas 'o na khyed rang dad na shog chos kyi zhabs tog bya yis gsungs so/ /de nas dgun de sgom khang du byon nas gdams pa zhus pa las/ smin grol gnyis su byas nas/ smin pa'i dbang la bde mchog lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang bzhi rdzogs dang /

phag mo lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang bzhi rdzogs dang / de'i byin rlabs lan bzhi zhus/ grol lam skyed rdzogs gnyis las bskyed rim lha bcu gsum ma dang / phag mo lha bcu gsum ma dang / zhal gnyis ma dang / dpa' bo gcig pa dang bzhi zhus/ rdzogs rim la thabs shes gnyis las/ shes rab ni phyag rgya chen po lam du slong ba'i thun 'jog thabs lam la bka' babs bzhi ste/ phyag na rdo rje/ blo gros rin chen/ des klu sgrub/ des ma tang gi la/ des tai lo pa la bshad do/ /de ni 'pho ba dang grong 'jug gi rgyud pa'o/ /bram ze chen pos lu hi pa des ḍoṃ bhi pa la/ des tai lo pa la bshad do/ /de 'od gsal gyi rgyud pa'o/ /su ma ti kun tu bzang mos thang lo pa la/ des shing lo pa la/ des kar+ṇa ri pa la/ des tai lo pa la bshad do/ /gtum mo'i rgyud pa'o/ /slob dpon ḍoṃ bhi he ru kas/ tshang tshong ma bī na si la/ des lwa wa pa la/ des tai lo pa la bshad do/ /de ni sgyu lus dang bar do'i rgyud pa'o/ /de'ang sgyu lus dang rmi lam la/ slob dpon klu sgrub dus bzhi 'du ba'i gnad yin pas mgrin par a nu ta ra la 'dzin gsungs/ su ma ti kun tu bzang mo rnam par shes pa 'du ba'i gnad yin pas smin phrag tu thig le dkar po gcig la 'dzin gsungs/ lwa wa pa gtso bo yid kyi rnam par shes pa yin pas snying kha'i dkyil du mar me rtse sor bzhi pa gcig la 'dzin gsungs/ bla ma de la thabs lam gyi gdams pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig 'dug ngas kyang mang du zhus so/ /de nas bla ma'i zhal nas sgoms shig mtshams dam po bcad nas zla ba bcu gcig rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas/ nub gcig gi rmi lam na/ brag 'phrang dog po gcig na phar phyin pa dang / rbab tu shor ba dang / rmi lam legs par zin pa bla ma la bshad pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyod snying rus dang bsags pa yang rab gcig 'dug pas/ nā ro pa'i zhal nas/ dbang po rab tu gyur pa la/ /lo yis zin pa dag kyang srid/

/gsungs pas/ khyod kyis mi lus don can du song / skye ba nas skye ba'i don grub pa yin/ de bla ma'i thugs rje/ ḍa ki'i byin rlabs yin pas/ bla ma ḍa ki la gtang rag chen po thongs shig gsungs nas bur btang gcig dang / gser zho drug btsongs nas sgom khang na bzhugs pa rnams la tshogs mchod byas/ de nas dgun smad bla ma'i phyugs thum drag tum pas khyer nas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ ngas las su chos byas/ don du lha gnyer ba yin/ mi tshe chos la bskyal ba yin te/ phyugs thum de yang dgras khyer/ da nga la ni mthu med/ ran+na bir+ya khyod kyis ser ba thongs shig sa lam mang po bgrod pa yin no gsungs/ dbyar nyi khros kyi ser ba btang bas/ gyang rim gsum tsam babs/ mi phyugs mang po shi/ lo thog gcig kyang med/ mthu ser gnyis ka stabs su byung zer nas babs byed du byung ba la/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyod ser ba 'bebs mkhan yin pas babs len du rgyug gsungs nas phyin pas/ ser bas mi phyugs mang po shi/ byi'u shi ba'i ro lud phung tsam 'dug pas skyo shas drag po skyes so/ /de nas drag tum pas phyugs rnams gtad/ rta dang g.yu khrab la sogs pa'i yus chen po byas pa rnams/ bla ma la phul nas/ ngas chos la 'ongs pa yin te/ sdig pa ci yang byas nas 'dug pas/ da nga dmyal ba min pa 'gro sa mi 'dug byas nas ngus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyod kyis bla ma dang bstan pa'i ched du byas pas sdig pa ci yang mi yong ba'i steng du/ sa lam mang po bgrod pa yin no/ /cis kyang blo mi bde na mtshams med pa lnga byas pa yang sangs rgya ba'i gdams ngag bar do dug gi tsher ma dang / dug gi thur ma bya ba yod pa sbyin gyis gsungs nas gdams ngag mang po gnang / de'i dus su rje btsun ma'i zhal yang mthong / da khyod kyi mgon po dang nyi khros gnyis nga la phul zhig gsungs nas bla ma la phul lo/ /de nas nya ka mo pa'i dge bshes dkon mchog 'khar ba la/

spyan snga ba'i sgom rim dang / lam rim dang / rab gnas dang / bden chung zhus/ dge bshes rdza ra ba la bka' gdams pa'i gdams ngag mang du zhus nas/ slob dpon g.yor mo can du lo lnga phar phyin dang spyod 'jug zhus so/ /de nas nyung sgom rgod po la sems sbyang / sungs pa kha thor ba gsum zhus so/ /de nas rgyags kyang zad pa dang / pha rgan gum zer nas 'bod du byung / nam zla dpyid dus su song yang skya nam bzang bas sha mar gser gsum mod par byung bas zhing btsongs dge ba byas/ de tshar ba dang rgya grags bsod la sbyor drug gi rdo rje'i tshig rkang la sogs pa'i gdams pa mang du zhus/ dge bshes gzhu pa la phyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i gsang sngags la 'jug pa dang / nang nyams su len pa'i yig chung dang / sgom skyon sel ba'i bdud rtsi dug sel zhus/ slob dpon zhang la 'dul ba 'od ldan dang sum brgya pa la sogs pa mang du zhus/ dge bshes 'bal sgom phyag na la zhi byed la sogs pa mang du zhus/ de nas rgyags kyi grabs byas nas/ slob dpon g.yor po can du chos nyan du 'gro dgos snyam tsa na/ bla ma zhong zhong pa can du mjal du phyin pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyod med pa'i shul du pha shi ba yin te/ dge ba bzang po 'grub 'dug gis/ khyod kyis na ning bar du slob dpon g.yor po can du bsdad dam/ phar phyin rnams shes sam gsungs pa la/ 'di na yod dus su 'brom ston na re/ /gros blo nyes po la dris sgoms zer/ ma ki dbus su ston pa gcig dang phrad pas/ po ti theg tshad gcig khur nas brang rdung ba las mi 'dug pas/ chos bslabs kyang ji tsam shes kyang cha med/ shes kyang sems la ni mi phan par 'dug snyam nas/ khams pa a seng dang / bur sgom nag po can du chos zhus nas sgom pas rmi lam en re zin/ rje btsun ma'i zhal mthong / de nas lo lnga g.yor po can du chos nyan/ da dung rgyags khyer nas 'gro dgos snyam pa 'dogs zhus pas/

bla ma'i zhal nas btsun chung khyod kyis shes na dga' ba'i phar phyin mi shes par/ ma shes na dga' ba'i rdzun gcig shes par 'dug khyod kyis rmi lam zin pa dang rje btsun ma'i zhal mthong ba gnyis ka byung ngam/ da nga'i rtsar ma sdod gsungs/ de nas nam phyed tsam na shog gsungs/ phyin tsa na bla ma'i zhal nas/ da lta sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas dang / yi dam ḍā ki mang po byon nas/ khyod kyi chig rgyud kyi gdams pa rnams 'di la byin zhig 'dis khyod kyi rgyud pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro gsungs pas/ da nga yang na so rgas pa dang / yun ring sdod long med pas gzim g.yog gyis/ yul gzhis rnams btsongs la dbang zhus/ chos thams cad myur du tshar bar bya yis gsungs pa la/ bla ma gzim g.yog byed pa mi thob pa tsam du 'dug ngas khams pa dang grwa pa rgod la tshan che ba 'di tsho'i gseb tu gzim g.yog mi yong bas/ phyi'i gzims khang gi dkon gnyer byed par zhu byas pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ ci nas kyang gzim g.yog gyis/ byin rlabs 'jug pa yin gsungs pas/ gzim g.yog byas so/ /de nas yul gzhis btsongs nas la las dbang zhus/ la las gser du sgyur nas gser chos rnams zhus/ gser gyis ma ldang bar tshong pa brdzangs nas gser phul te chos zhus so/ /de la rtsa ba'i bla ma bzhi'i gdams ngag ma lus pa gcig zhu dgos byas pas/ thog mar bla ma ra hu la'i gdams ngag rnams bstan gyis gsungs nas/ rgyud sde lnga'i dbang bskur nas/ rgyud sde lnga so so'i dbang bzhi rdzogs dang / sgrub thabs dang / bde mchog rtsa rgyud dang / ra li dang / sgrub thabs lu hi pa dang / dpa' bo gcig pa dang / mahā mā yā rgyud sgrub thabs dang bcas pa dang / gur/ brtag gnyis/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes rdo rje dang / mtshon cha can/ de nyid bzhi'i sgrub thabs/ gsang 'dus sgrub thabs dang bcas pa dang / 'jigs byed rtog pa bdun pa dang / dgra nag gi rgyud rtog pa gsum pa dang /

lha lnga'i dril sgrub dang / dgos sgrub dang / mgon po dang / mkha' spyod dkar dmar la sogs pa sgrub thabs mang du zhus so/ /rdzogs rim la 'khor lo lnga'i rdzogs rim/ rim lnga/ gdan thog gcig ma dang / rlung bum pa can dang / shing rta can dang / 'khor lo bcings grol dang / 'pho ba ye shes skar khung ma la sogs pa dang / mahā mu dra/ do ha/ dag pa ye shes la sogs pa'i ngo sprod mang du gsungs/ kri ya la mi g.yo ba'i rgyud sgrub thabs dang bcas pa dang / phyag na rdo rje'i rgyud 'byung po 'dul byed dang / ja li ma'i sgrub thabs dang / rnam 'joms dang / don yod zhags pa la sogs pa dang / dbu ma bden gnyis dang / yo ga ngan song sbyong rgyud dang / rdo rje rtse mo la sogs pa mang du gsungs so/ /de nas phyi dro gcig gdugs la bzhud pa'i dus su/ ngas khyod la ltad mo gcig bstan gyis gsungs nas/ bstan khar dgra nag dang / 'jigs byed dang / mi g.yo ba dang / phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i khro bo mang po phra lam me bzhugs nas chos gsungs/ nyin gcig sgrol ma dkar mo dang / ljang ser du bzhugs nas phyag 'tshal nyer gcig 'don gyin gda'/ de nas gser phul nas ye shes kyi ḍā ki ma gnyis kyi gdams pa rnams zhu dgos zhus pas/ tshogs mchod brgya rtsa lan gnyis gyis gsungs nas tshogs mchod tshar ba dang / ḍā ki ma ni gu ma'i sgyu lus rmi lam spyi'i dbang bskur/ de nas chos drug gi dbang dang gdams pa rnams spel zhing khrid tshar bar mdzad/ rgyud sde chen po lnga'i dbang skur/ de nas sgos kyi dbang skur nas/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud dang / ma hā mā yā dang / brtag gnyis dang / gsang 'dus dang / 'jigs byed rnams kyi sgrub thabs zhus/ mtshon cha can gyi de nyid bzhi'i sgrub thabs dang / de'i rdzogs rim gyi zhal gdams rnams zhus/ bde mchog bcu gsum dang / lha lnga ma dang / mkha' spyod ma dkar dmar dang / rgyud sde bzhi'i grib sel dang /

rje btsun ma'i sgrub thabs dang / rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs dang / 'pho ba lnga bcu dang / thabs lam gyi rigs mi 'dra ba sum cu dang / lus sbyong bcu gsum ma dang / kri ya dpung bzang dang / klu'i sgrub thabs la sogs pa mang du zhus/ su kha ma sid+dhi'i gsang sgrub dang / lte ba sprul 'khor dang / bdag med ma'i nang khrid zhus/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i bde mchog lha lnga dang / mkha' spyod dkar dmar dang / yin+d+ra bhu ti dang / ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun dang / thabs lam dang / 'pho ba dang / bar do la sogs pa mang du zhus so/ /de nas rtsa ba'i bla ma bzhi'i chos rnams tshar ba yin pas/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i chos rnams byed dgos gsungs nas/ rgyud sde chen po lngar dbang bskur/ 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs rdo rje 'od la sogs pa rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang gdams ngag mang du zhus/ mi g.yo ba dang / phyag rdor dang / rnam 'joms dang / grwa lnga dang / rnam rgyal dang / 'jam dpal dkar ser dang / gdugs dkar dang / 'od zer can la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs rnams mang du zhus so/ /bla ma mai tri pa'i brtag gnyis dang / do ha dang mgon po dang / thabs lam la sogs pa mang du zhus so/ /de nas tshes bcu bzhi'i pu dza'i dgongs bla ma'i zhal nas do nub lha bzhi sgoms la/ nam langs ma thag nga'i rtsar shog zhig gsung / nam phyed na lha bzhi bsgoms nas nam langs pa dang / bla ma'i rtsar phyin pas gdan kha na lha bzhi sngags kyi sgra di ri ri sgrogs gyin 'dug pa dang / lha bzhi mthong ngam gsungs/ mthong lags zhus pas/ da nga dang lha bzhi tha dad du ma lta ang gsungs so/ /yang tshes brgyad kyi snga dro nga la ja drongs gsungs nas ja 'dren du phyin tsa na rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs su bzhugs nas gtso 'khor thams cad rang rang gi sngags 'dren gyin 'dug pa dang / de nas bzung nas nga'i bla ma 'di dang lha tshogs rnams dbyer med du 'dug snyam pa dang /

sangs rgyas dngos su 'dug pas nga re 'tsheng snyam pa dus rgyun du byung ngo / /des bla ma'i zhal nas/ da nga yun ring po mi sdod pa 'dra gsungs/ de ci lags zhus pas/ mdang rgya gar lho phyogs na bzhugs pa'i bla ma rnams byon nas dbang skur mdzad de/ 'di na gdul bya mi che bar 'dug pas rgya gar lho phyogs su gshegs 'tshal gsungs/ na ning byon pa'i bla ma rnams dang mgon po tshe dpag med byon nas gshegs 'tshal zer ba la/ ngas khas blangs yod pas rje btsun ma'i thang sku 'di dang / ka pā la dang / thod pa dang / dges rdor gyi rdo sku 'di dang / bum pa 'di rnams khyod khyer zhig da bsgrub pa tshul bzhin gyis shig nga rang gi byin gyis rlob pa yin pas gsol ba thob cig sgrub pa la bar chad kyis ma khyer ba gyis/ sgom pa la mi gnod pa gcig las med do/ /yengs med du bsgrubs shig gsungs/ gcig po de gang lags zhus pas/ rtse gcig tu sgom pa gcig pu yin no/ /gsungs so/ /bdag gis bla ma chen po de sngar lo lnga brten/ phyis lo gcig dang zla ba bdun bsten nas sku gshegs so/ /de nas bla ma sku gshegs nas lha dang sku 'bum ma tshar bar la g.yog gang dgos thams cad byas/ cha rkyen ci yod thams cad bla ma'i phyogs su btang nas/ dbyar dgun gnyis kyi zla ba la bla ma'i mdzad pa thams cad tshar bar byas so/ /de nas bdag gi rtog pa la/ de snga phan chad bla ma'i zhabs tog yin/ da btub tshad kyis sgom dgos snyam pa byung nas/ btub tshad kyis sgoms/ de nas sding mar phyin nas/ khong la gnas g.yar nas/ lo gnyis su mtshams dam po bcas nas bsgoms pas/ sgyu ma lta bu 'di la blo yang 'gro ba gcig byung ngo / /bsam pas 'od gsal gtan la 'bebs pa sgyu mar 'dug sgyu ma gtan la 'bebs pa rmi lam du 'dug rmi lam gtan la 'bebs pa dad 'dun du 'dug dad 'dun ston par byed pa bla mar 'dug des na rtsa ba'i bla ma la rag lus pa gcig 'dug go

/de yang rmi lam 'khrul pa'i shes pa de/ rgyu ru go ste rmi lam du shes/ rmi lam bden med sgyu mar shes pa de/ lam du go de 'od gsal du shes pa de 'bras bur go de la bsre ba rnam pa bzhi yang tshang ste/ rmi lam gyi gnas skabs su yul sna tshogs su shar ba de dang / da ltar gyi gnas skabs su/ snang ba sna tshogs su snang ba 'di gnyis shar ba'i sgo nas kyang mnyam ste/ snang ba'i sgo nas kyang mnyam/ rmi lam gyi dus su yul snang sna tshogs su shar ba de yang / kho rang la shar/ snang yang kho rang gi ngo bo la snang / snang ba'i sgo nas kyang khyad par med do snyam du go don byed nus pa'i sgo nas kyang khyad par med de/ rmi lam gyi dus su sna tshogs su shar ba des kyang chags sdang skye ba'i don byed nus te/ don byed nus pa'i sgo nas kyang khyad par med par go shes nas grol ba'i sgo nas kyang khyad par med pa yin te/ rmi lam gyi dus su rmi lam du shes na grol gyin 'dug de bzhin du da ltar yang sgyu ma lta bur shes na chags sdang las grol gyin 'dug des na shes na grol ba'i sgo nas kyang khyad par med par go de yang rgyud sde rnam pa bzhi yang rmi lam la tshang nas 'gro bar gda' ste/ des na chos gcig gtan la phab na chos thams cad der 'dus nas 'ong bar 'dug de la shes pa kha tshon thum zhig rang la tshang nas 'ong bar 'dug ste/ mi dge ba'i bag chags kyi rmi lam ci rmis pa thams cad log shes su 'gro bar 'dug de rmi lam la rmi lam du shes pa de kun rdzob pa'i shes rab tu 'gro bar 'dug sgyu ma tsam gyis 'dzin pa dang bral nas 'od gsal lam chos nyid du shes pa'i shes rab de don dam shes pa'i shes rab tu 'gro bar 'dug des na shes pa gsum po de yang gnyid thun gcig la tshang nas 'ong bar 'dug go /yang phyag rgya rnam bzhi yang sgyu ma lta bu'i rtog pa de la tshang nas 'ong bar 'dug ste/ rmi lam la rmi lam du shes pa'i dus na chags sdang dang bral nas sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa de kho na dam tshig phyag gi rgyar 'ong bar 'dug

nyon mongs pa thams cad khos spong bar byed pas/ las kyi phyag rgyar 'ong bar 'dug de ltar sgyu ma lta bur nyams su len pa de chos kyi phyag rgyar 'gro bar 'dug sgyu ma mtha' bral du rtogs pa de phyag rgya chen po 'gro bar 'dug yang sgyu ma lta bu'i rtogs pa de la rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum yang tshang nas 'ong bar 'dug ste/ sgyu ma'i rang bzhin la skye ba med pas rnam par thar par sgo stong pa nyid du 'dug sgyu ma'i rang bzhin la cir yang grub pa med pas rnam par thar pa'i sgo mtshan ma med par 'dug sgyu ma zung 'jug tu rtogs pas na rnam par thar pa'i sgo smon pa med par 'dug ste/ de yang ngas rmi lam zin pa'i dus su rmi lam yin pas/ ji ltar byas kyang sprul du btub snyam nas skad gcig ma la mdun gyi nam mkha' bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas mang po sprul/ skad cig gnyis pa la pu dza'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul te/ de thams cad rim pas phul nas bsngo ba yan chad byas pa la tshegs med pa byung bas sgyu lus kyi gdams pa 'di ka ngo mtshar che bar byung ngo / /yang bdag gis rmi lam bzung nas u rgyan du dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten can du phyin pas/ phyogs bzhi nas sgo bzhi 'dug pa ma phyed pa dang / nam mkha' nas lha mo dkar mo gcig gi zhal nas/ sngon nas bsgrubs pa'i yi dam lha/ /de ring gang yin bdag snyems pas/ /rigs dang mthun pa'i dngos grub dang / /lha dang ma nor mjal bar shog /gyis la gsol ba thob cig gsungs nas gsol ba btab pas/ phyogs phyogs nas sgo rang phye ste/ rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs kyis dbang rdzogs su bskur nas/ ḍā ki ma la gdams pa zhus shig gsungs nas lung bstan no/ /de nas ḍā ki ma kun tu bzang mo sangs rgyas dang skal ba mnyam pa des/ de nyid bzhi dang rigs lnga'i gdams pa rnams gsungs so/ /yang bla ma'i 'das mchod kyi dgong mo gsol ba btab pas rkyen byas nas u rgyan du phyin te/

rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti btsun mo'i tshogs kyis bskor nas gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha dang dbyer med du 'dug pa la/ pha rgyud kyi gdams pa 'ga' zhus/ dur khrod chen po mun pa mi zad pa na ḍā ki ma seng ge'i gdong can bzhugs pa la mahā mā yā'i lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ yang u rgyan gyi dur khrod he ru ka mngon par 'byung ba'i gnas su phyin pas/ phag mo lha bdun la pu dza phul dbang bskur nas byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba'i thabs zhus nas nyams su blangs pas/ rmi lam gyi stobs chen po byung nas nges shes gting skye bar byung ngo / /de nas rmi lam kyi stobs chen por gyur nas skabs su yul snang ji lta ba bzhin gtan la phab/ tho rangs kyi cha la 'od gsal re rtag tu 'char ba byung bas/ da nga'i dge sbyor 'di bzang ngan ci tsam yin nam/ bla ma yang mi bzhugs su la dri snyam tsa na/ rje sgam po pa bya ba bya rgod po la sgom thebs pa'i grub thob chen po gcig bzhugs zhes thos nas snga ba'i dang khyad par ci 'dug lta dgos snyam nas/ mtshams bkrol nas yul du phyin te/ zhing lhag ma yod pa btsongs pas/ gser zho bcu gcig khugs pa dang / bur sdang gsum khyer nas dbus su phyin te/ lam du nad kyi btab kyang na gin phyin nas/ slob dpon g.yor po can du phyin tsa na/ lus la mkhris pa dang / 'khrug pa dang / sbrid pa la sogs pa byung nas/ 'di mdze 'ong ba'i rtags su 'dug snyam nas/ dgun hril gyis mdze bzlas byas kyang nub gcig shin tu na bar byung bas/ tho rangs rje btsun ma la gsol ba btab pas/ rje btsun ma byon nas khyod kyi 'di gdon min nad yin pas/ sman pa la ston sos par 'gyur ro/ /gsungs nas/ nangs par slob dpon la nga'i 'di gdon du mi 'dug nad du 'dug pas phar bskyal dgos byas pas bur du bskyal lo/ /de nas sgom khang du phyin tsa na/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyod ci tsug song na'am gsung /

na lags zhus pas/ lha rje bos shig gsungs nas lha rje la bstan pas/ 'di nad du 'dug pas myur du sel dgos par 'dug zer nas/ sman mang po btang bas mkhris 'khrug la sogs pa rnams zhi'o/ /de dus su dge bshes rdor rgyal byung nas/ chos ston pa'i yon gyis rgyags byas nas bla ma nā ro pa'i gdams pa rnams zhu yin 'dug bla ma yang khong la chos gsan zhing 'dug der khong dang lo rgyus mang po byas pas/ bla ma 'dzims lo ts+tsha ba la chos mang po zhus 'dug 'dzims kyi bla ma 'di byang chub sems dpa' yin zer bas/ bla ma zhong zhong pa'i yang bla ma yin pas/ rgyud pa gcig par 'dug kyang 'dir zhus pas mi yong / gtsang du zhus dgos snyam yod tsa na/ nub gcig rje btsun ma byon nas/ phar la 'gro mi dgos 'o brgyal/ jo bo 'di gdams pa can gcig 'dug pas 'di la nyon zhig gsungs pas/ khong ja la dges par 'dug pas ja bskol nas drangs/ ja mang tshad gcig phul nas/ bla ma 'dzims pa'i gdams ngag rnams zhu dgos byas pas/ 'o skol gnyis phar zhu tshur zhu bya yin gsungs nas dges nas byung / da g.yar po 'di stabs su sdod gsungs nas/ bla ma 'dzims kyi phag mo kem rus kyi drwa ba dang / mkha' spyod sgrub pa dang / rdzogs rim rnam gsum dang / rtsa kha bcu pa'i gdams pa dang / dbyangs can ma dang / nor rgyun ma dang / bsam mi khyab dang / rim lnga rim kyi sa dang / bde mchog dpa' bo gcig pa dang / bir+wa pa'i lam rgyas pa dang / ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa'i yi ge bzhi pa'i gdams pa rnams khong la zhus/ mkhar snar zhag gcig bsdad pa'i tho rangs ka bde mchog lha drug cu gnyis kyi zhal mthong / de nas ston kha g.yor po smad du phyin nas/ gnas gzhi gcig gi khyim na bsdad nas yod dus/ btsun chung gcig byung nas jo bo gang nas 'ongs pa yin zer ba la/ g.yas ru shangs nas 'ongs pa yin byas pas/ bla ma shangs pa gdub bu ba'i gdams pa shes sam zer/

shes byas pas log nas song / de nas en tsam gcig nas khong byung nas ja la shog zer nas phyin pas/ dge bshes dmar chos rgyal gyi mtshams su 'dug khong gis ja bur gcig byas nas rlung shing rta can zhu dgos zer nas bshad snyam tsa na rmi lam log nas shing rta can ma bshad par/ rje btsun ma rgyud gsum ma dang / byin gyis brlabs pa'i lha bzhi bshad/ dge bshes dmar zhang tshan gnyis kyis snam bu dang / dar yug lnga dang / lam rgyags skur nas gzhung 'da' gnas su zhag gcig bsdad pas/ btsun ma gcig byung nas jo bo gang nas 'ongs zer/ shangs nas 'ongs byas pas shangs pa gdub bu ba'i gdams pa shes sam zer/ shes byas pas btsun ma de en tsam gcig nas yang byung nas/ nga la shog zer nas phyin pas mo la ming po gnas brtan gcig 'dug nas des ber dang za 'og gi gdan bting ja bur byas nas kho na re/ nga gnas brtan yin pas mi rta mang po bsad sdig pa ci yang byas yod pas/ rgas khar gdams pa gcig zhus la bsgom dgos snyam nas bla ma su bzang dris pas/ bla ma shangs pa gdub bu ba bya ba grub thob chen po gcig la sdig po che btsan thabs su sangs rgya ba'i 'pho ba ye shes skar khung ma bya ba yod zer nas zhu ru phyin pas bla ma de 'das zer ba thos nas/ shangs mda' rang nas mi chen stong tsho gcig 'gyes dgos pa byung bas/ da nged la mgon po dang 'pho ba de gnyis gnang dgos ngas 'bul ba yang bzang du byed zer nas de la khas blangs/ khams su phyin pas nam srod la rmi lam na lha mo dkar mo gcig lci ba kham kham za yin 'dug nas/ khyod lha mo dkar mo legs pa gcig lci ba za ba ci tsug yin byas pas/ khyod kyang gsang sngags kyi chos zab mo nor la bltas nas 'tshong ba ci tsug yin zer nas/ da gdams ngag bshad du mi btub pa 'dug snyam pa byung ngo / /yang tho rangs rmi lam na mi gcig gi mgo lus med pa chu bur gyis khengs 'dug pas/ de rdol nas de la rnag khrag mang po 'dzag cing /

zug rngu chen po rgyas nas cho nges 'debs kyin 'dug pa dang / de la ngas khyod la sdug bsngal chen po 'di lta bu 'ong ba ci yin dris pas/ kho na re ngas theg pa chen po gsang sngags tshe 'di'i ched du bshad pas sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba drag po nyams su myong ba yin zer bas ngas kyang sngar gyi de dran pas nga la yang yong las che snyam tsa na/ kho'i nad sdug bsngal de nga la gos nas sdug bsngal dpag du med pa byung ba la/ rmi lam du shes pas sdug bsngal de yal nas song / de nas las rgyu 'bras la nges shes gting nas skye ba gcig byung ngo / /de nas ngas kho snga mor 'bod du byung gis dogs nas/ nam langs pa la bros phyin/ de nas grwa thang du slebs tsa na/ bla ma lha rje'i drung du 'gro ba'i gtsang pa dge bshes 'bul skyel tshan gcig dang 'dzom/ de'i dus su bang ston zer ba'i bsod nams pa dang gleng mo byas pas/ kho mos nas nga'i khres po khur nas/ so khu do zer ba'i gnas phyug gcig tu slebs tsa na/ srod la kha ba chen po gcig babs pas/ bla ma'i slob ma gzhan rnams byung ba dang / gtsang pa'i 'bul skyel ba rnams na re/ bla ma tom lung na bzhugs na 'u cag rnams dang dgun po 'di mi mjal/ zer nas sdug bsngal chen po byed kyin 'dug pas/ ngas rmi lam btab la lta'am byas pas/ 'o na ltos dang zer bas/ tho rangs rmi lam bzung nas bltas pas bla ma tom lung na mi bzhugs par 'dug de na sdod pa nyer gcig 'dug de ma yin pa'i grong dang thag nye ba'i brag ri shin tu mtho ba gcig gi mdun na bla ma bzhugs pa mthong nas/ nam langs pa dang khong rnams na re/ khyed la mo'am rmi ltas ci lta bu byung zer ba la bla ma tom lung dang zangs lung ni mi bzhugs par grong dang nye ba'i brag ri shin tu mtho ba gcig gi mdun na bzhugs 'dug mo'am rmi lam bden na de lta bu gcig na bzhugs 'dug byas pas/ khong rgyus ma rnams na re/

bla ma sgam po rang na bzhugs par 'dug zer/ de nas 'phrang thams cad la 'jigs pa 'ong mi 'ong gi rmi lam thob cig zer/ rmi lam bzung nas bltas pas thog tu phebs par byung nas/ khong rnams na re/ khyod rmi lam rnon po rang 'dug pas/ btsun chung rmi lam rnon po ming thogs shig zer nas btags so/ /de nas gang dbar dbye nang du slebs tsa na grwa pa dang 'phrad pa la bris pas/ bla ma tom lung nas sgam por byon yod zer nas/ dge bshes de rnams na re khyod la rmi lam rnon po rang 'dug zer ro/ /de nas sgam po'i bla ye la slebs tsa na/ bla ma sku la thang pa rkyang pa gcig gsol/ spa 'khar gcig bsnams nas dar yug gcig khyer ste bla ye bar byon nas/ ngas da ci bar khyed rnams ma mthong bar 'dug da bsu ba byed dgos khres po zhog la ma tshad rgyug cig gsungs nas/ nged rnams kyis ma tshad phyin pa dang / dge bshes rnams na re/ da res bla ma mnyes nas bsu ba byed par 'dug zer tsa na/ dar yug de nga'i lag tu brkyang / spa 'khar de nga'i mdun du btsugs nas/ nga'i bu de 'ongs sam/ skye ba mang po'i dpon slob yin pa la/ skye ba 'di la da res las ma 'phrad gsungs tsa na spyan chab gcig bton nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /skye ba mang po'i sngon rol nas/ /'o skol gnyis po dpon slob yin/ /dam tshig ngo lkog med pa yis/ /da res sgam po'i brag la 'dzom/ /nga'i bu de 'dir 'ongs sam/ /mos gus can de 'dir 'ongs sam/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i mgur gsungs pas/ rang dbang med par mchi ma byung ste/ zhi gnas bzang po dus der byung ngo / /de nas bla ma'i gzims khang du phyag rten phul nas/ nga'i bla ma shangs pa de 'das nas/ dge sbyor byas pas/ thabs lam dang sgyu lus rmi lam 'od gsal gyi nyams 'di lta bu skyes pas/ 'di mthar thug tu sleb pa'am ma sleb zhur 'ongs pa yin/ bla ma shangs pa chen po 'das pas/ bla ma min pa zhu sa ma rnyed pa yin/

da chos drug gi khrid tshar gcig kyang zhu dgos byas pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas chos drug gi nyams rtogs bzang po skyes 'dug ste/ lta ba la thag chod gcig bstan dgos par 'dug gsungs nas/ mahā mu dra'i tshig rkang brgyad pa dang / ngo sprod lnga po gsungs pas/ lta ba'i phyogs la yid ches par byung ngo / /de nas bla ma'i zhal nas khyed rang rgyags grabs gyis la sgom tshul la chos drug tshar gcig nyon/ ngas chos drug tu sgrub thabs mi 'chad pa'i dam bca' byas yod gsungs/ bla ma mi gsungs na sgom tshul bas nga rang grag pas mi zhu byas pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas 'o na khyed rang rmi lam la dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin pas do nub rmi lam zung la shog khrid bya yis gsungs so/ /de nas spyil por phyin nas nam phyed bar du gsol ba btab/ tho rangs kyi cha la rmi lam bzung nas bla ma'i spyan sngar phyin pas/ bla mas chos drug tshar gcig gsungs nas gnyid de ma sad bar du skyongs/ gnyid sad nas kyang ma brjed par 'dug nas sang yang de ma brjed par bskyangs so/ /de nas bla ma'i spyan sngar phyin nas/ mdang bla mas gsungs pa'i chos drug po 'di la lhag chad gda' 'am mi gda' zhus pas/ chos bzhi po 'di nan tan dag por 'dug 'pho ba dang grong 'jug gnyis la lhag chad bag tsam 'dug pas dngos su bya yis gsungs nas tshar gcig gsungs so/ /de nas yang snga dro phyin nas rmi lam dang dngos su gsungs pa la khyad ci bdog nyams len byed pa dang / gzhan la bton pa gang zab zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ ngas dang po pu rangs pa byang chub sems dpa'i chos sgor zhugs/ khong la gdams ngag zhus nas bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin bzang po byung / phyis bstan pa'i rim pa'i khrid byas/ de nas dka' thub gcig byas pas ting nge 'dzin de shor nas song / de nas sngags kyi gdams pa gcig btsal dgos snyam nas dris pas/ brin snya nang gi ri la mi la ras pa bya ba'i grub thob gcig bzhugs zer ba thos nas/

mtshan thos pa tsam gyis ba spu ldang zhing mchi ma 'khrug pa gcig byung / de smon lam gyi 'brel pa yod tshod du 'dug de nub gsol ba btab pa rmi lam du mjal nas gdams pa btab pa gcig rmis/ gnyid sad pa dang yang blo la lhag ge 'dug de nas bla ma dang mjal nas gdams pa zhus pa'i dus na/ sngar gyi de las khyad par ma byung ngo / /bla ma'i zhal nas dngos dang rmi lam la khyad par med de/ de 'dra ba'i sgo nas rmi lam gyi de stobs che'o/ /khyod kyi de ka bzhin du 'dug gis/ rmi lam gyi de la ston pa dang nyams len gnyis ka gyis shig yid ches par bya ba'i ched du bya yis gsungs/ nangs par gtor ma gcig khyer la shog gsungs nas/ thabs lam gyis sna grangs pa'i chos drug dang / jo bo nas brgyud pa'i dang / mi la'i rnams tshar bar mdzad/ dpe rnams dge bshes gar la yod kyis khong la zhus gsungs/ de nas dge bshes gar la dar yug gcig phul nas/ phyag dpe rnams ma lus par zhus pas/ jo bo khyed chos la nan tan byed pa chos dang mthun pa gcig 'dug pas dpe rnams btang gis gsungs nas/ jo bo nas rgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi chos skor dgu dang / ḍā ki ma'i snyan rgyud dang / lta sgom chen mo thun mong ma yin pa'i skor dang / nor bu phreng ba/ phag mo/ bde mchog dpa' bo gcig pa sgrol ma dkar mo/ lhan cig skyes sbyor/ rkyen bzhi dang de rnams zhus so/ /mi la ras pa nas brgyud pa la/ thabs lam la sogs pa'i chos drug go cha lam 'khyer/ be bum sngon po/ stong thun/ rje btsun ma zhal gcig ma/ bde mchog lha lnga/ thabs lam mi 'dra ba nyi shu tham pa/ gzhan yang ngo sprod kyi gdams pa mang du zhus so/ /bla ma rang gis mdzad pa'i go cha rnam gnyis dang / ngo sprod lnga dang / tshig rkang brgyad pa dang / sku gsum lam 'khyer la sogs pa'i mahā mu tra'i gdams pa rnams ma lus par gnang nas/ khyed la bla ma'i gdams ngag gi dpe dang zhal gdams thams cad ma lus par rdzogs pa yin no/

/gsungs so/ /khong shin tu bka' drin che la thugs rje che ba gcig gda'o/ /de nas yang bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis lta ba thag chod par byung ba dang / sgyu ma la yang ji ltar sbyangs sbyangs su 'gro ba gcig byung ste/ nub gcig gi rmi lam na bya rog tu byas te/ 'da' na grogs po gcig yod pa'i gam du phyin te/ khong de na mi 'dug par tshong 'dus nas nyin gcig 'ongs pa'am sa na 'dug mar la log nas sgam po'i brag der babs tsa na/ pho rog gi lus de rje btsun mar gyur nas song bas/ dmyal ba'i gnas dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams thams cad dus gcig la mthong nas/ rang gi lus la bltas pas chos 'di rnams dang ldan par 'dug nas/ de'i dus su/ skye med klong nas 'gag med 'phyo/ /bsam pa tsam gyis thogs pa med/ /gang gis slur med sgyu ma'i sku/ /rnal 'byor rig pa'i klong nas shar/ /tshe 'di'i rnam rtog yal nas thal/ /rnam smin lus la rgyal ba'i sku/ /ngo sprod kyi rje btsun rin po che/ /bag chags kyi lus la rgyal ba'i sku/ /ngo sprod kyiྎ yid kyi lus la rgyal ba'i sku/ /ngo sprod kyiྎ bya ba la sogs pa'i mgur blangs pa lags/ dus de nas tshe 'di'i rnam rtog tsam skye ma myong gda'/ bdag gis bla ma de lo gcig tsam bsten nas mahā mu dra'i gdams ngag ma lus par zhus pas/ lta ba la sems thag bsha' mar chod pa gcig byung ngo / /de nas yar la 'ong ba'i dus su bla ma la phyag 'tshal nas/ da 'tsho ba gar bder 'gro dgos pa gda' bas/ dus rgyun du thugs rjes bzung bar zhus/ da lta yang byin rlabs gcig zhu byas pas/ bla mas skyel thung mdzad nas/ phyag g.yas pa bdag gi mgo thog tu bzhag nas/ bu dus rgyun du dran par gyis/ gnas gzhi'i go chod ma byed/ dgra dga' ba'i 'dun ma gyis shig dge 'dun gyi bya ba ma byed gzhan smos ci dgos gsungs nas/ da ri khrod 'grims la dus rgyun du ri'i bu gyis/

bde bar 'ong bar 'dug gis/ ngas skyas chen po 'degs tsa na bu'i rtsar yug gcig 'ong gis gsungs so/ /de nas yar la 'ongs nas bsam yas su slebs tsa na/ rnal 'byor chos 'byung dang phrad nas/ rmi lam du khyung du sprul ba 'di ka dka' bar byung byas pas/ khong na re/ khyod rang lha khang du song la ltos dang / nga la yang des phan par byung zer ro/ /rnal 'byor pa na re khyung dag sla ste/ dung de ka dka' bar byung zer nas de la ngas bslabs so/ /de nas snye'i mkhar nag 'di gdug pa che bar 'dug pas/ nged gnyis gros byas gdul bar byas tsa na/ ngas rta mgrin dang / bya rog mar byas nas mkhar nag tu phyin pas/ kho rgya gar du bros/ de tshur bkug nas kho rang gi pho brang rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i nang du phyin nas/ khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med par sprul nas gtul ba dang / de nas kho klu nag po sbrul mgo bdun pa gcig tu song ba dang / kha nas khrag rgyangs rgyangs bskyugs nas bla ma grub thob chen po de ltar mi mdzad par zhu/ da ni bdag gis srog sngags phul nas bka' bsrungs bgyi'o/ /zer tsa na/ rnal 'byor chos 'byung hab tab can des khyung gcig tu byas nas kho khyur gyis mid pa dang / ngas srog sngags 'bri long ma byung yang kho thul nas spyir sems can la gnod pa chung du song / dgos su nga'i rgyud pa 'dzin pa la bar chad mi nus par 'dug go /de nas slob dpon g.yor po can du yong tsa na btsun pa gcig na re/ rgyun 'dir bzhugs nga yis zhabs tog bya yis zer nas dgon pa 'dre can gcig du lo gcig bsdad pas/ dgongs gcig slob dpon byon nas/ khyod kyis do nub dpon chos dga'i khyim 'di gtan la phob gcig nangs par nga 'dir 'ong gis gsung / de'i nub mo khong gi khyim ji lta ba bzhin gtan la phab nas/ slob dpon la bshad pas thugs ches nas/ ngo mtshar shin tu che bar byung 'dug glang ma ring mo bya ba'i dgon pa gcig yod pa yin te/

der 'dre gcig zhugs nas mi phyugs mang po dus gcig la shi/ gser g.yu mang po sbas pa yang ma rnyed/ rnyed kyang 'dre des bdag du bzung nas len ma nus pas/ da dgon pa de gtan la phob la 'dre de thul zhig gsungs nas/ nub gsum byi ba dang / byi la/ spyang khyi la sogs pa gang 'dul gyi gnyen por sprul nas gtul bas/ zhag gsum la gtan la phab nas dam la thogs te gser g.yu sbas pa rnams bton nas slob dpon la phul bas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ bla ma shangs pa des nga la chos che gog pa de tsam gcig byin nas/ gdams ngag khyad 'phags 'di rnams ma byin par 'dug pas/ nga na so rgas 'chi ba la nye bas/ khyod kyi gdams pa rnams ster dgos zer nas byung ba la/ ngas slob dpon la chos bshad pas mi yong byas nas ma byin pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas khyod nga la gdams pa ci yang mi ster na/ nga la chu bo ri'i klu bdud 'dis en re gnod pa byung bas thul zhig gsungs pas/ ngas 'jigs byed du byas nas btul bas khos dbang zhus srog sngags phul nas slob dpon g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod pa mi byed par khas blangs so/ /yang slob dpon gyi zhal nas so sha 'di thul zhig gsungs nas srod la rmi lam bzung nas khyung dang khro bo'i tshogs su sprul nas nam mkha' la phyin pas so sha kho mdun du byung nas phyag 'tshal skor ba byas nas/ de ring nas bdag bran du bgyid do/ /bla ma yar ldog par zhu zer nas/ 'o na khyod rang gi ming dang gzugs ston byas pas/ mi gzugs che ba sha ser ba/ ral pa ser sha re ba gcig tu byas nas bdag gi ming dge ba stag zhes bgyi'o/ /da dge bsnyen du gnang du gsol zer nas dge bsnyen du byas so/ /de nas tho rangs kyi rmi lam na/ khyim gcig gi phug na rin po che'i phung po gcig 'dug pa la/ mi srin po'i cha byad can mang pos mgo snol nas rin po che len du mi ster ba gcig mthong /

de la bdag gis bsams pas/ khyim dang 'dra ba bdag gi lus su 'dug rin po che dang 'dra ba rang gi sems su 'dug mi srin po'i cha byad 'dra ba dug lnga 'dis rtogs su mi ster bar 'dug snyam pa gcig byung ba dang / mdun gyi nam mkha' la rje btsun ma mang po byon nas/ rigs kyi bu de kho na bzhin yin no gsungs so/ /de'i rjes su rje btsun ma la zhe sa phul ba'i mgur ba'i mgur de blangs pa yin no/ /de nas yar la 'ongs nas bla ma'i gsung bzhin du ri dang ma bral ba gcig byas la/ yang na shi ba gcig yang na sangs rgya ba gcig la bsdad dgos snyam nas rmog cog gi brag la bsdad pas/ a ne khrom lcam gyis zla ba re la nas bre lnga lnga bskyal nas sgrub pa lo gcig byas tsa na/ nyin gcig a ne byung nas/ rin chen brtson 'grus khyod bsos kyang skyed ni gcig kyang mi 'ong bar 'dug da ngas nas bre do las mi 'khyol bar 'dug zer nas dgun gcig bre do re bskyal lo/ /de nas yang a ne byung nas/ pha spun 'di kun nu bo'i rgyud yin te/ nyin re la sha mar mang po yong gin 'dug khyod phu bo'i rgyud yin te/ mi yongs pa'i chos 'di 'dra gcig byas pas nang zas med/ nub gos med pa gcig byung 'dug gis/ da khyed bsos pas skyed ni gcig kyang mi yong ba 'dug a ne nga yang rgas pas mi sleb par 'dug zer nas bre do yang skyel du ma 'dod do/ /de nas rgan mo gcig la nyung gzhi gcig blangs nas brag logs na phar btab te/ dbyar nyung tshod byas/ dgun lo ma'i tshod ma byas pas/ tsha rdor dag nam yang med de/ thal yang med pas/ thal bas kha sgyur gyin 'thungs nas dge sbyor byas pas/ dang po rlung langs nas khams za zir byung / phyis snying rus skyes nas gsol ba drag po btab pas/ tho rangs gcig su kha ma sid+dhi byon nas/ chos nyid mngon du ma gyur tshe/ /mi zas 'tsho bas nyams myong 'grib/ /lto gos 'phri ba bcad nas kyang /

/mi rtog ting 'dzin zas su zo/ /lan gsum gsungs pas lto gos kyi 'phri ba chod do/ /de nas dgun zla 'bring po'i tshes bcu gcig la/ mi g.yo ba nam mkha' khengs pa khro chung bcus bskor ba gcig mthong / yang tshes bdun gyi dgong mo chu blangs nas 'ongs tsa na/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng byin gyis brlabs pa'i lha bzhi sgo rer bzhugs nas rang rang gi sngags di ri ri sgrogs kyis 'dug pa mthong nas/ de ka nas lha bzhi'i dril bsgrub de la mos par byung ba dang / yang lha bzhi byon nas lha bzhi'i lag len khod cig gsungs nas lung bstan byung bas/ de dus su tshigs bcad pa de bkod pa yin no/ /yang nub gcig nam phyed yol tsam na mgon po gtso 'khor lnga byon nas/ 'cham gyin 'dug pas nga yang nyams 'bar nas rtags bstod byed kyin skor ba byas pas shin tu mnyes so/ /lha 'dre yang dbyangs bstod la mnyes par 'dug bsam pa gcig byung ngo / /bla ma shangs pa'i pu tsa'i dgong mo pu dza ni med pas/ yon chab dang me tog phul nas gsol ba btab pas bla ma dang 'od dpag med byon nas dbu ma bdud rtsis gang ba'i tshe bsgrub de gsungs pa yin no/ /de nas nub gcig rmi lam bzung nas u rgyan du phyin pas phag mo lha bcu gsum gyis dbang bskur nas/ rnam smin lus la rgyal ba'i sku/ /bde stong gnyis su med par ltos/ /rmi lam lus la sgyu ma'i sku/ /gsal stong gnyis su med par ltos/ /yid kyi lus la lha'i sku/ /rig stong gnyis su med par ltos/ /gsungs pas lus ngag gi gnas lugs thag chod pa gcig byung ngo / /de nas rta zla'i tshes brgyad kyis dgong mo lha'i bu dang bu mo ḍā ki ma mang po pu dza byas pas rkyen byas pas 'od gsal gyi stobs chen po byung ste/ gnyid dang rmi lam gyi bar shed nas/ mi rtogs gsal ba'i sgron me rnyed/ /la sogs pa'i mgur de yang de dus na blangs pa yin/ de'i dus na lha phu'i phyi nang thams cad mthong ba byung ngo /

/de nas rgya je che la mched nas thal/ de nas nam zla sos ka brag zur du phyin pas/ nyin mtshan dbyer med kyi snang ba byung nas chu'i sprul bsgyur byas pas lug rdzi gcig mthong ba byung ngo / /mer bsgyur ba ldom bu ba gcig gis mthong / de nas zad par bzhi stobs chen por gyur/ yang zad par ser po sngon po la sogs pa'i snang ba mched nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams mang po mthong ba byung bas/ bzang spyod kyi/ rdul gcig steng na rdul rnyed sangs rgyas rnams/ /bya ba de nyid du 'dug snyam pa byung ngo / /yang nyin gcig brag steng du phyin pas sgyu ma'i nyams bzang po byung ba dang / nam mkha' la rje btsun ma ḍā ki ma'i tshogs kyis bskor nas gar sgyur ba mthong ba dang gnyid kyi stobs kyis ngas kyang brag la sogs kyi thad ka'i nam mkha' la dkyil dkrung bca' nus pa byung ngo / /de lug rdzi gcig dang bu mo 'gas mthong 'dug pas/ de'i nangs par lha phu nas phyug po'i gces phrug ma bcu drug gis sha mar dang snam bu khyer nas phul/ bsnyen gnas zhus nas song / lo bcu gnyis la brag logs la phye mar dang sha snam de ka las ma mthong ngo / /de nas zhag bcu gcig nas shangs nas phyug po rgad po gcig byung nas/ rin chen brtson 'grus khyod kyis lo bcu gnyis su brag 'di la tsam pa mig gis ma mthong bar bsdad pas da khyod kyis grub pa thob nas nam mkha' la dkyil mo dkrung bca' yin 'dug zer bas/ da nga na so rgas shi la thug tshogs bsogs gcig byed dgos par yod pas/ de la khyod cis kyang byon dgos zer bas/ ngas khyod kyi tshogs bsog dang chos 'khor gyi slob dpon mi yong bas/ khyod rang gzhan la chos byas pas/ kho na re khyod da res mi yong na nga 'di nyid du lcebs nas sdod pa yin zer nas snying khar gri gtad nas byung bas/ khyod de tsam la thug na zhag gsum las mi sdod do byas/ de nas khos rta khrid nas byung nas bem dug de gyon/

chos khug de khur byas nas phyin pa dang / khrom chen po 'tshogs nas 'dug khos chos khri mthon po gcig brtsigs/ de'i steng na gos dar mang po bting nas snang rta phyugs dang mar nas la sogs pa'i 'bul ba mang po byas nas khos gtam btang ba/ slob dpon rin chen brtson 'grus khyed kyis na ning bar lo bcu gnyis tsam pa mig gis ma mthong bar brag la bsgoms pas da grub pa thob 'dug pas/ de ring gi skabs su bla ma'i zhal nas bya ba'am/ mdo rgyud nas 'di gsungs bya ba ma bshad par/ ngas lo bcu gnyis su tsam pa mig gis ma mthong bar bsgrubs pas 'di rgyud la skyes pa yin bya ba'i chos gcig gsungs shig zer nas/ ngas nyi ma dang po la dad pa'i dang kha bde ba/ brtson 'grus kyi la gor myur ba/ sgyu ma lam du bslangs pa/ stong nyid kyi spar khar sleb pa bya ba dang / bzhi po de la rtsa ba byas nas bshad pas/ phyug po de dang khrom thams cad mos nas/ nangs par yang thams cad kyis 'bul ba byas nas chos zhag gnyis su bshad pas/ tshong 'dus dang / 'jang bo dong man chad 'dus nas rta khrab dang bur tshos dang gser g.yu ras snam la sogs pa'i 'bul ba ci yang byung nas/ phyug po de la 'bul ba byung ba'i nor rnams ma 'dres par gcig kyang ma khod par gyis shig byas pas/ kho na re/ na ning bar phye mig gis ma mthong bas bden pa yin te/ da cha rkyen la de tsam zhed mi 'tshal/ mi gser du red pa bya ba yin pas/ nor zad kyis dogs pa dang / ltogs kyis dogs pa mi 'tshal lo zer/ de nas 'bul ba byed pa thams cad bsdus nas kha sang bar nga la phul bas bsod nams thob pa yin/ da khyed rang rnams kyis 'bul ba gang byas pa rnams ma god par yod pas ma nor bar khyer zhig nga la nor gyis ci btub/ nor la ngas ci btub/ gnyis ka log pas ci btub byas nas phye bre gsum dang / shog bu deb gcig khyer nas brag la byon no/ /de nas btsun pa byed pa dang /

chos sgor 'jug pa'i grwa pa mang po 'dus nas/ bla ma ra hu la dang / jo bo rje dang / bla ma bur sgom dang / bla ma lha rje'i gdams pa rnams bstan pas dge sbyor bzang po byung ngo / /bla ma bzang ba dang nga rang yang blo sna thung ba'i stobs kyis/ blo bcos kyi bshad pa mang po dgos pa ma byung ste/ nga bla ye la phyin pa'i dus su/ 'jig rten gyi bya bzhag zin med la/ brel po gcig sngon du byed byed nas/ tshe long med sang 'chi gnang 'chi 'di/ chos ring po gcig yod pa shul du lus/ byas nas mgur blangs pa tsam gyis blo sna rang dbang med par 'gyur nas tshe 'di'i chags zhen dang bral te/ sgrub pa byed pa sha stag byung ngo / /de nas bya'i zla ba'i tshes nyi shu la bla ma bur sgom sku gshegs nas rmi lam du byon nas sre 'pho'i chos 'ga' gsungs/ yang sding ma kha na yod tsa na slob dpon g.yor po sku gshegs nas byon pa rmis te dus tshod de brjed gda'/ nang gong gi brag la yod tsa na ston zla tha chung gi nya la bla ma rin po che lha rje sku gshegs nas byon te/ phyag rgya chen po rtsa bral gsungs/ bla ma rnams dang / dam tshig la zol sogs dang / mos gus la ngo lkog mi btub snyam nas mos gus gting nas skye bar byung ngo / /yang brag la mtshams gcig byas nas yod pa'i smin drug gi zla ba'i tshes gsum gyi tho rangs rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs nam mkha' khengs pa mthong / yang de'i tshes bcu drug gi dgong mo rmi lam bzung nas po ta lar phyin nas don yod zhags pa zhus/ de nas rmi lam du rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs zhal mthong nas/ da rmi lam sprul sgyur gyi mchod pa gcig phul dgos snyam tsa na/ lha'i bu mo bye ba tsam gcig sprul/ lha mo re re la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi pu dza thogs pa'i lha mo 'bum tsho re sprul/ 'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal po 'bum phrag lnga la rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun khri khrag res skor ba sprul/

nam mkha' thams cad gser dngul dang pad+ma ku mu da la sogs pa lha'i me tog gi char 'bab par sprul nas mchod pas/ de rnams thams cad gcig gis gcig ma bsgribs par gsal bar byung nas/ dus der bla ma'i drin dran nas mos gus dang 'brel ba'i sprul sgyur blo'i yul las 'das pa byung bas/ rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs rnams/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta bu'i mchod pa ni ches khyad par du 'phags pa'o/ /zhes lan gsum gsungs nas/ da chos gcig zhu dgos snyam tsa na gnyid sad nas chos zhu ba ma byung ngo / /mdor na rmi lam sgyu lus rmi lam dang 'od gsal 'dres pa'i nyams myong 'di ka ngo mtshar che bar mthong / gzhan la phan du re ba'i nyams myong zlas pa dang rang gi de 'grib par byung / des na nyams myong skyes pa gsang ba 'di gal che bar 'dug go /bla ma lha rje'i zhal nas sems kyi ngo bo mthong nas bshad pas mi sto gsungs pa yin te/ nyams myong gsang ba 'di kho na gdams ngag gi gnad du gda'o/ /de'i yang nya la bla ma lha rje'i pu dza la ci yod btang bas/ ye shes kyi ḍā ki ma ni gu ma byon nas rdo rje'i tshig rkang dang / 'jam gcod thengs gsum gsungs/ bla ma sgrub pa'i gnad kyang sngar bas zhib pa gcig gsungs pas bla ma thams cad srog gcig par 'dug bsod nams kyi tshogs bsogs pa dang / mos gus kho na gal che bar 'dug snyam pa gcig byung ngo / /de nas bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pas blo sna yang thung bar byung / snying rje yang rtsol med du 'char ba byung / blo 'di yang phyogs ris dang bral ba gcig byung bas nga'i ming ngam/ mgur thos pa'am/ dgon pa mthong ba tsam gyis dge sbyor bzang po skye bar byung ste/ nga'i slob ma ras pa gsum gyis la stod byang du lha gcig 'od 'bum la mgur blangs pas/ mo mos gus thun mong ma yin pa skyes te khyim thab spangs nas chos la mos nas byung bas lam du dge sbyor bzang po skyes nas nga dang phrad tsa na/

rtogs pa'i ngo bo la bogs 'don rgyu ma byung / phyis nas ras ma mang po'i dpon byas nas 'khor ba spangs nas u rgyan du song / yang mnga' ris pa ston rgyal rmog cog nga mthong ba dang sems kyi ngo bo mthong ba dang 'od gsal mngon du gyur to/ /de la sogs pa rmog cog tu nga mthong ba dang / nga'i mgur thos pa dang / nga la gsol ba btab pa'i skad thos pa tsam gyis rmi lam zin pa dang 'od gsal 'char ba byung yang / snyigs ma'i sems can phrag dog che bas rgya ston nam mkha' kho rgya thams cad mkhyen pa la chos mi zhu bar/ rmog cog pa sgom chen bya ba tsam zhig la 'di tsam 'du zer nas 'bar ba yin yang / kho la tshogs pa che dus su bar chad 'ong bar 'dug nas/ dge bshes la yang na tshe la bar chod 'ong / yang na chos dang 'khor la bar chad 'ong bar 'dug gis byas pas/ kho na re/ khyod kyis de skad byas nga khyod la chos zhu nges shes zer nas byung tsa na/ phyis nas khyim thab tu song ste grwa pa thams cad gyes nas/ chung mas thags byed/ bus ra lug 'tsho/ kho rang gis shing sgrug nas nga'i grwa pa'i zan lhag dang / gtor zan dang / tshong byed cing 'dug nas ngas kho la mgur 'di blangs so/ /bya ba nyes pa 'di bcos dka'/ /rgya ston nam mkha' phag shing sgrug /chos pa khyim thab byas pa 'di/ /'khor ba'i gting rdo byas pa yin/ /la sogs pa'i mgur blangs pas/ kho mos nas nga la dpe cha thams cad phul bshags pa byas nas/ kho nga'i gtor zan gyis gso dgos pa byung bas/ de bas na 'chi ba rgyud la skye ba'i chos gcig dgos par 'dug go /yang nub gcig gi rmi lam du rta bzang po bcu gsum 'bul ba gcig byung tsa na/ nang par bla ma lha rje'i dbu che bcu gsum nas bla ma rin po che'i mahā mu dra'i bka' thams cad khyed la babs pa yin pas rnam rtog gis mi gnod pa'i phyag rgya chen po zhu zer ba la/ skye 'gag med pa'i chos nyid la/ /rnam rtog bya ba ci la zer/

/mi rtog pa dang rnam rtog gnyis/ /chu dang chu bur lta bur ltos/ /la sogs pa'i mgur gsungs pas khong rnams kyis rtog pa gzhi med rtsa bral du rtogs so/ /yang glo bo'i dge bshes rgyal bas gser srang brgya bcu phul nas/ des sngar rgyud sde mang po nyan/ sgrub thabs mang po byas nas/ bsgrubs pas zhal ma mthong nas/ da yi dam gang sgrub kyang myur du zhal mthong ba'i gdams pa gcig zhu dgos zer ba la/ 'jig rten bya ba blos thong la/ /yid la the tshom med pa yis/ /lha sku gsal la rtog med bsgoms/ /'dzad med long gtam ma byed par/ /brag stong sngags kyi bzlas brjod gyis/ /de ltar byas na lha'i sku/ /myur du mthong bar the tshom med/ /byas pas kho de la nges shes skyes nas zla ba gnyis gsum bsgrubs pas sgrol ma'i zhal mthong nas nga'i tshig rnams gser gyis bris nas yar song ngo / /de nas rmog cog tu tshogs pa ma shong pas phan sems kyis sku lus su dgon pa btab ste/ snying rje dang phan sems 'ba' zhig gis tshogs pa skyong dgos bsam pa 'ba' zhig byas kyang / blo sna thung ba'i stobs kyis gnas dben par bsdad dgos snyam pa yang yang byung ba dang / tshes bdun gyi snga dro sangs rgyas sprul sku chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can nam mkha' khengs pa'i mdun na/ thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa/ sku shin tu che ba 'od kyi rang bzhin can gcig bzhugs nas/ snyigs ma'i sems can 'dren dus su/ /zhi bde'i spyod pa ma mdzad par/ /tshad med snying rjes gzhan don gyis/ /snod ldan gdul bya 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs nas phrag dog dang nga rgyal spangs te/ phan sems dang dag snang skyes nas res 'ga' chos bshad/ res 'ga' mtshams byas pas/ phyogs ris kyi grwa pa mi chen mang po 'dus pas gzhan don la phan sems dang / dag snang kho na gal che ba 'dug snyam pa skyes so/ /slob dpon byang chub sems dpa' g.yor po'i slob ma ston rin la rdo rje gdan pa'i rjes su yi rang ba gcig pu'i khrid byas pas/

bla ma dang mched grogs thams cad la dag snang 'byongs nas yi dam mang po'i zhal mthong nas dus bzhir rjes su yi rang gi gdams pa zhag nyer lnga nyer lnga ston pa'i dam bca' byas nas 'khrid dang bshad pa gnyis spel nas byas pas/ nga rang gis rmi lam bzung nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams mang po lta ba'i go phyed nas thal/ grwa pa rnams la yang dge sbyor gyi ston chen po skyes so/ /de nub gcig rmi lam bzung nas mngon dgar phyin pas/ sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa dang mjal nas/ yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa phul nas/ lung bstan du gsol ces gsol ba btab pas/ snang ba mtha' yas rim 'gro bas/ /bde ba can du spyan yang 'dren/ /mngon par dga' bar sangs rgyas nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ yang nub gcig rmi lam bzung nas su kha ma sid+dhi dang mjal du phyin pas/ nam mkha' rig med stong pa la/ /rig bcas sems kyi rtsa ba bcun/ /rtsa ba bcun dang lhug par zhog /ces gsungs nas mnyam bzhag rjes thob dbyer med du gyur to/ /de nas dbyar gcig mu ge chen po byung ba dang / yul mi ltogs pa rnams gros byas ste/ da bu smad ltogs nas 'chi bar 'dug pas bla ma la bka' babs gcig zhu dgos zer nas/ nga'i 'bul skyel dang grwa pa rnams bcom pas/ mgon g.yag ni grong la kha bltas/ grwa pa rnams ser dmag byed par 'dug nas/ nyin gcig mang skol gyis byas nas/ dang po'i bem po de gyon/ chos khug de khur byas nas/ lam mkhan bla ma rje la zhus pas/ /lam rgyus mkhas pa'i tshad gcig byung / /sgro 'dogs rang gi sems la chod/ /nges shes skyes pa'i tshad gcig byung / /zhes pa la sogs pa'i mgur blangs pas/ ri la bros pas grwa pa rnams kyis ser dmag bshol/ mgon g.yag kyang yar la log nas byung ba dang / thugs rje chen po'i zhal nas/ zhe sdang me dpung chen po de/ /byams pa'i chu yis bsil bar byas/ /shin tu legs po rnal 'byor pa/

/'khor 'dab chags sdang rtsa ba yin/ chags sdang skyungs shig rnal 'byor pa/ /gsungs so/ /de nas rta'i zla ba la mtshams byas nas mi zas ma zos/ dbang bskur ma byas pas 'od gsal gyi gsal snang chod nas/ grwa pa rnams kyi bya spyod/ tshe stod tshe smad kyi legs nyes shes pa byung ste/ snying rje dang sha tshas gang la legs kyis gros btab byas pas/ phal cher nges shes skyes nas dge sbyor mthar phyin par byung ba la/ ngam shod bla mchod la sogs pa'i mi nyan pa mang du byung nas/ kho yul du phyin pas khyim thab tu 'gro bar 'dug nas/ da nga 'chi la khad pas mi 'phrad par 'dug yul du ma 'gro byas pas ma nyan pa dang / yi mug nas kho'i lag pa nas bzung nas snying med po bcu gsum bya ba'i mgur gcig blangs so/ /la stod pa tshul rgyal dang / rta nag pa dkon rgyal dang / dbus pa ye shes rdo rje gsum gyis nyams myong phul nas da lta g.yas ru phyogs na nyams myong dang / btsun tshugs dang / snying rus su 'dzom pa nged gsum las med do zer nas byung ba la/ 'chi ba yid la ma skyes pa'i/ /nyams myong ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra/ /btsun po rgyal po'i btsun mo 'dra/ /snying rus dpyid ka'i chab ron 'dra/ /khyed gsum da lta kha po che bar 'dug ste/ lo 'ga' ri la ma bsgoms na khyim thab re byas nas mthar ltogs rir 'chi 'chi 'dra/ byas pas/ bla ma yang phrag dog byed par 'dug nged gsum 'dra bas chos mgo ma thon na/ grwa pa 'di rnams kyis chos mthar phyin pa gcig kyang mi yong zer nas khong rnams log lta skyes so/ /de nas yang shangs chung pa gtor g.yog byed pa'i/ bya spyod ngan pa 'dra rmi lam du mthong nas 'bar bas/ kho yul du phyin nas khyi ra byed par byung nas kho tsha ba skyel ba'i dus su thugs rje chen por byas nas mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa bton pas/ khos thugs rje chen por mthong / yang rje btsun sgrol ma dang phag mor byas pas mthong nas der kho dad pas bshags pa byas/

nga la rkus pa'i cha rkyen dang phyugs ma nga la phul nas bsgoms pas rmi lam gyi stobs nga dang mnyam la khad pa byung ngo / /des na snyigs ma'i sems can bzang ngan 'bring gsum skyong ba la sha tsha phan sems skyong dub med pa gsum 'dzom pa gcig dgos par 'dug ste/ nga rtag tu skyo shas skye bar byung bas/ res 'ga' gzhon byed pa bdud yin snyam pa byung ngo / /de'ang mkhas pa dran ston la sogs pa'i mi chen brgyad cu la rgyud sde lnga'i dbang bskur byas pas/ byin rlabs phab pa'i dus su nga'i gnas lnga dang / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi rgyud sde chen po lnga'i lha tshogs dngos su gyur par byung nas/ da res thams cad kyis mthong las che snyam nas dris pas/ dran ston mtha' bral gyis sna drangs pa'i bcu gsum gyis mthong / dus rtag tu rmi lam 'od gsal gyi nyams dang ldan pa byung ngo / /dbang bskur byas tshad la 'ong las che snyam tsa na/ dris skabs en re las ma byung bas/ 'o de dus su dpon slob kyi rten 'brel 'dzom pa las byung 'dug pas/ des nas skye ba thams cad du rten 'brel dag pa 'ba' zhig sgrig pa gal che bar gda' 'o/ /de nas ston zla 'bring po'i tshes gcig gi nyin mo rta gzugs shin tu che ba lta bas chog mi shes pa khrid pa gcig gis lha'i na bza' pañca li ka dang lha'i me tog yin zer ba mang po phul nas/ nga la phyag 'tshal skor ba byed cing 'dug nas/ khyod kyis gang nas 'ongs byas pas/ bde ba can nas 'ongs/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi rim 'gro ba yin/ nga gdan 'dren du 'ongs pa yin pas chibs pa 'di la chibs nas bde ba can du gshegs 'tshal/ da res byon na rnam smin gyi sgyu lus ma spangs shing dag nas 'ja' lus su 'gyur te/ bde ba can du skad cig yud tsam gyis bgrod nas dus de nyid kyi cha/ yun mi ring ba la mngon dga'i zhing du phyin nas der mdzad pa rdzogs par 'gyur ro zer ba dang /

nga da res mi 'gro slob ma rnams la bla ma shangs pa'i chos rnams ster dgos pa yod byas pas/ da res byon na rnam smin gyi lus 'di bzhag mi dgos pa yin te/ da slob ma rnams kyi rgyud chos kyis tshim par byas te/ nam zhig rnam smin gyis lus bzhag nas bde ba can du sangs rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas lo gsum gyi bar la chos lhag ma rnams dang / zab chos rnams tshar bar byas pas/ khyed rnams la dge sbyor bzang po skyes pas bsdad rin chog pa de yin no/ /de nas nyin gcig rin po che'i zhal nas/ slob dpon jo btsun la mang ja skol gyis la dge 'dun pa rnams la spong dag gyis gsungs nas/ sku khams ma bde ba 'dra ba cang gda' 'am zhus pas/ na so rgas pa 'di la blo gtad mi gda' gsungs so/ /de nas snyung gzhi tsam med pa la tshogs su byon spong dag byas nas da dge 'dun thams cad kyis de ring nga spyi bor sgoms la gsol ba thob cig nga spyir bla ma rnams kyi byin gyis rlabs pa gcig yin/ khyad par bla ma shangs pas byin gyis rlabs shing / bla ma yi dam rnams kyis dngos su lung bstan dngos grub thob pa gcig lags pas/ gus pa dang bcas pas gsol ba drag tu thob cig dge sbyor ma skyes pa rnams skye/ skyes pa rnams gnas/ gnas pa rnams bogs gong du thon pa yin no/ /nga'i yang chos kyi phyi ma lo rgyus kyi'ang tha ma yin pas/ da man chad shar phyogs mngon par dga' bar gsol ba drag tu thob cig gsungs nas gzim khang du byon no/ /de nas rin po che 'da' ba'i do nub nam phyed na slob dpon jo btsun gyis sgom pa byang she lo rar bos nas/ snang ba 'dra ba mthong ngam byas pas/ ma mthong zer nas 'o na gzim chung du song la ltos dang byas pas/ der mi 'gro 'di kar bsdad la lta yis byas pas/ bltas pas mthong lugs brjod pas/ tshes bco brgyad nam gyi gung phyed na/

ma mthong bya ba'i dgu gcig mthong / /btsan gyi rta pa khrom du 'tshogs/ /der 'tshogs nang nas dbang che ba/ /mdzes pa'i stag dong g.yas na bkra/ /ral gri dngul ma g.yon na 'tsher/ /lus la shel gyi me long 'bar/ /phyag pas gser gyi lcag chen bsnams/ 'og na rta gro smug chen po/ /tsho 'gyogs spu rtsa rngul ba la/ /zab chen hor stan grub bzhi la/ /dar tshon sna lngas bsrub ma btang / /mdangs ldan dngul gyi sga srab la/ /mtsho ro g.yu yi gzer bus brgyan/ /gong smed gnyis po dngul gyis byas/ /rin chen sna lnga'i phra yis brgyan/ /blo ni mu tig dkar dmar la/ /rdo chu mtshal gyi ri mo bris/ /rin chen gser gyi chab mas bsdams/ /ngo mtshar dngul gyi srab mgo la/ /mdzes pa gser gyi 'bur mgo btab/ /mtsho ro g.yu'i smin 'khyugs can/ /srab skyogs byi ru dmar po bsgrigs/ /srab mda' dngul dkar pho long ris/ /lag pa g.yas na khyer nas kyang / /pha rje btsun gyi drung du 'bul ba lags/ /rje yis zhal 'dzum lan gsum mdzad/ /de ltar gong gi rta phul bas/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ khyod kyi rta bzang chas legs sga srab 'dzom/ khyod kyi rta 'di blo yul du mi shong / khyed cag gang yin nga yis ngo ma shes gsungs pa las/ btsan gyis lan btab nas zhu don phul ba/ kye ma dpal mgon rin po che/ /rje yis bdag ngo ma shes na/ /'brong phu'i btsan rgod dregs pa can/ /sngon tshe rje la gdams pa zhus/ /mched grogs 'bal gyi gdan gcig yin/ /sngon chad khas blangs dam bcas la/ /sdom khrims nyes pas phog pa med/ /phyin chad de yi rjes su 'brang / /mdang gsum rje btsun snyung ba thos/ /blo ni ma bde snyun 'dri byed/ /bred cing sngangs nas rings par 'ongs/ /rje la chibs bzang 'bul du mchis/ /zhen pa gting nas log pa dang / /'dzin med nyams su myong ba yis/ /rta la dgos pa mi bdog kyang / /bdag gi don du bzhes par zhu/ /tha snyad sgro 'dogs gcod du mchis/

/nyams len gdams pa zhu ru 'ongs/ /rje btsun sku khams mtsho dang sbyor/ /snyung ba'i rkyen ni gang gis bgyis/ /da lta snyung ba ji ltar snyung / /'phral gyi zug gzer ji tsam mchis/ /phugs kyi rkyen du mi 'gro'am/ /rje chos kyi dbyings su mi gshegs sam/ /nged bu slob shul du mi 'jog gam/ /sngon chad rje yi gsung la nyan/ /da yang re sa rje las med/ /phyin chad thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ yang rin po ches gsungs pa/ skyes bu khyed kyi dam tshig bsrungs/ /sdom pa zhig ral med pa de/ /gzhan gyi ched min rang don lags/ /spro ni bla ma bdag kyang spro/ /na ba'i rkyen ni 'dis lan med/ /nad gzhi nad bu'i steng na yod/ /na so rgas pas na zug chung / /phugs kyi rkyen du cha las che/ /lus sems gnyis po bzang gyes byed/ /dag pa mngon dga'i zhing du 'gro/ /bdag ni de ring sang gi mi/ /tha snyad chos la bshad long med/ /nyams len gdams pa zhu ba na/ /khas blangs sdom pa srog dang sdongs/ /khyod rang bsgrub bya gang 'dod pa/ /phyin chad bdag la gsol ba thob/ /mos na nges shes 'phral du skye/ /dad na rgyun gyi sdig pa 'dag /khyod kyi tshogs rnams rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /lan gcig srab mda' blangs pa tsam/ /rta yis nga la dgos pa med/ /khyod kyi sun ma 'di rnams kyang / /mkha' la 'dug pa ma mthong ngam/ /mkha' 'gro brgya dang brgyad bcu dang / /lha yi tshogs kyis bar snang khengs/ /mdzes pa'i gar dang snyan pa'i sgra/ /rol mo sna tshogs sgra snyan sgrogs/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs/ /ma 'dres so so 'ja' tshon 'dra/ /'di ru mi sdod pha rol 'gro/ /rnam shes rlung la zhon nas 'gro/ /'jig rten rta la dgos pa med/ /grogs byang chub sems dpa' dang 'grogs nas 'gro/ /gson po rnams dang bral te mchi/ /sems nyid yid bzhin nor dang bcas te 'gro /zang zing nor la dgos pa med/ /bstan nam mkhar dang 'grogs nas 'gro/

/khyed bu slob shul du las te mchi/ /lam sna bla ma rnams kyis 'dren/ /'dzin med nyams dang 'grogs nas 'gro/ /blo 'das gsal ba rtogs pa dang / /gnas lugs dang la gnas pa yis/ /khyed kyis zhus pa'i lan ldon pa/ /gnyen po bsten kyang gnas lugs ngang / /mgo nag mi yi 'khor gyis dgos pa med/ /bsu skyel lha dang mkha' 'gros byed/ /lha 'dre'i 'khor gyis dgos pa med/ /tshig legs zhu 'bul rna bar snyan/ /'phral spyod legs pa spyan la mdzes/ /thugs gting nas dad pa skyes pa yis/ /chibs rta brgyan can phul ba dang / /snyung 'dri 'ongs pa cha byad bzang / /rgyu 'bras 'brel ba mi bslu bas/ /gnas skabs kyi bde the tshom med/ /mthar thug gi 'bras bu 'byin te mchi/ /phyin chad bka' bzhin bsgrubs la gsung bzhin nyon/ /bu btsan gyi thugs la de ltar zhog /de skad gsungs pas/ btsan gyis bla ma 'da' bar shes nas smre sngags bton pa dang / mkha' 'gro rnams kyis mthong lugs bstan pas bla ma 'da' bar shes nas/ mos pa'i tshig gis smre sngags gsol ba/ snang srid lha 'dres cho nges btab/ /yi dwags rnams kyis pus mo btsugs/ /gzhan yang btsan gyi rta pa rnams/ /rta rnams rngul bas skor ba byas/ /gzhi bdag ku lungs btsan gyis kyang / /gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol ba btab/ /mkha' 'gro chas bzang sprin bzhin bstibs/ /bdun bdun bsdebs nas bsu ba mdzad/ /lha'i bu mo mdzes ma rnams/ /mi che mi chung lang 'tshor ldan/ /rin chen brgyan gyis brgyan pa rnams/ /snyan pa'i sgra sgrogs bar snang khengs/ /phyi lor yul rnams khol ba mthong / /bar snang sum sgril sgril ba mthong / /sum gril gnam du langs pa mthong / /de la rgya mdud skur ba mthong / /'dud pa rang sar grol ba mthong / /de snang ba gtad med du ston par go/ ༈ //de nas bu slob rnams tshogs nas bla ma 'di nas gang du gshegs gsol ba gang du btab/ bla ma'i chos rgyud gang gis 'dzin par 'gyur zhus pas/
